origin_rule: target_year-horizon; no intervening realized outcomes or population used
transform: ua_foreign_incoming subtracted from incoming; all other historical total incoming retained only for terminal variants

target_definitions.actual_total: regional incoming through boundary of region
target_definitions.actual_clean: regional total incoming minus foreign incoming of Ukrainian citizens; includes other classifications and war effects; no causal interpretation

metrics: MAE/RMSE/bias by all2017–2021,precovid2017–2019,covid2020–2021; equal matched target years across all models/variants; relative_improvement_vs_B1/B2=1-model_MAE/reference_MAE, undefined for zero denominator
config_selection: original incoming locked configurations reused without new tuning or winner selection
futures: For2022 only verified history through2021; no observed2022 file read
exposure: Original implementation: last observed population held fixed for recursive horizons; all exposure predates target
